sourceBinding.basis: Root recorded clean committed source; the log files do not embed SHA or clean-tree snapshots.

routeComparison.interpretation: Both authenticated 128-block probes succeeded. Process duration includes child startup. Sequential single samples with uncontrolled provider load do not establish throughput or causal latency improvement.

directCatchup.exitEvidence: Root process completion; captured log ends watcher.stopped.
directCatchup.interpretation: The direct route also throttled. Exit 0 records bounded diagnostic completion; the last sampled reserve is zero and P6 remains unproven. Values are not post-cleanup persisted state.

commands.routes: bun tools/stand-lock.ts run --reason "p6-rpc-route-comparison" --timeout-ms "60000" -- bun -e "const results=[]; for(const rpc of [\"https://sepolia.xln.finance/rpc\",\"https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com\"]){const started=performance.now();const child=Bun.spawn([\"bun\",\".logs/crisis-20261011/probe-public-rpc-rejection.ts\"],{env:{...process.env,P6_PROBE_RPC_URL:rpc},stdout:\"inherit\",stderr:\"inherit\"}); results.push({rpc,exitCode:await child.exited,ms:Math.round(performance.now()-started)});} console.log(JSON.stringify({comparison:results}));process.exit(results.some(result=>result.exitCode!==0)?1:0);"

secretReview.excluded: No private WAL, database, profile, seed or key was copied.
secretReview.limitation: Targeted content inspection and assignment-pattern scan are not an exhaustive secret-detection guarantee.

limitations: Ignored diagnostic scripts and the private restored-runtime profile are excluded; logs are observed evidence, not a standalone reproducer.
No new source, contract, browser, CI or financial recovery correctness claim is made.
